item.description: New: Settings list the permissions Bolo holds and what each is for, and the first run asks for each, with Not Now on the optional ones. Fixed: Check for Updates… says when a newer version is ready, and the update window comes to the front.

New: Bolo can keep your recordings (Keep Recordings in Settings), and they follow you to a new Mac in your settings folder. New: The card shows the version. Better: The pill's bars move with your voice in any room, even when you speak quietly. Better: Each dictation shows its app's icon level with its words, and the Dictionary says Delete. Fixed: Bolo hears a quiet voice through AirPods or any microphone you choose, and Settings lists only real ones. Fixed: If Claude answers late, Bolo keeps the tidied text so you can paste it. To try: At home, pick your AirPods in Settings under Microphone and dictate a sentence. To try: Take one AirPod out mid-sentence. Your words should still be pasted. To try: Dictate quietly and watch the bars. Still to do: Bolo is not yet good in a noisy room. Better: In Epic, said marks ("comma", "period", "plan colon") become marks, numbers become digits with short units (5 mg, 3-0 Vicryl, POD 2), and surgical drug and device names are spelled right. To try: In Epic, dictate a short plan with a dose and a suture, saying the punctuation.
